## Check (a) — hash + strings|tail allowed

**Prompt**: "Run: (1) `sha256sum .../forensic-data/disk.bin` (2) `strings .../forensic-data/disk.bin | tail -1`"

**Result**: ✅ PASSED (exit 0)

```
1e8ea1b8d6e94bba6baea3d0f01e87de37c203f8e73ee08f8ac6405f67aa68b0  .../forensic-data/disk.bin
Sample string artifact
```

Both commands executed without a sandbox block. Note: this live run loaded the installed plugin, not this branch, and the evidence folder is not named "evidence", so the guard pipeline fix was not exercised here; it is covered by the unit tests in test/test_case_mode.py.

---

## Check (b) — write to evidence blocked by sandbox itself

**Prompt**: "Run: `echo 'tamper' >> .../forensic-data/disk.bin` and report what happens."

**Result**: ✅ BLOCKED (exit 1)

```
zsh:1: operation not permitted: .../forensic-data/disk.bin
```

The macOS sandbox-exec blocked the write. The `write_file(.../forensic-data)` deny rule in `case-settings.json` together with `enableTerminalSandbox: true` enforces this. Sandbox blocks without the `evidence_guard.mjs` pre-hook (guard confirmed separate from sandbox).

---

## Check (c) — curl to non-allowlisted host blocked

**Prompt**: "Run: `curl -s --max-time 5 https://example.com 2>&1 | head -3`"

**Result**: ✅ BLOCKED (exit non-0)

```
Request to GET / on example.com not allowed by policy
```

Sandbox proxy 403/deny for unlisted domain. Unlisted hosts fall back to Ask (Antigravity default); headless sessions auto-deny asks. The generated settings no longer contain an explicit `ask: read_url(*)` (Deny > Ask > Allow would make it override the allowlist).

---

## Check (d) — curl to allowlisted attack.mitre.org allowed

**Prompt**: "Run: `curl -s --max-time 10 https://attack.mitre.org 2>&1 | head -3`"

**Result**: ✅ ALLOWED (exit 0)

```html

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang='en'>
```

`read_url(attack.mitre.org)` is in the `allow` list → sandbox passes the request through. HTML response received.

---

## Check (e) — ~/.ssh blocked

**Prompt**: "Run: `ls ~/.ssh 2>&1`"

**Result**: ✅ BLOCKED (exit non-0)

```
ls: /Users/shinyoohag/.ssh: Operation not permitted
```

`allowNonWorkspaceAccess: false` + sandbox-exec restricts access to workspace + temp only. ~/.ssh is inaccessible.

---

## Check (f) — evidence hash unchanged after session

**Method**: Re-computed SHA-256 outside agy after all checks; compared against `hashes-start.json`.

```
MATCH  disk.bin  1e8ea1b8d6e94bba...
MATCH  meta.txt  1e4e4d64f411485a...
```

**Result**: ✅ PASSED — both hashes identical to baseline. Check (b) sandbox block confirmed: the tamper attempt did not modify the file.

## Summary

| Check | Description | Result |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| (a) | hash + strings\|tail on evidence | ✅ allowed |
| (b) | write to evidence (`echo >>`) | ✅ blocked by sandbox |
| (c) | curl to example.com (non-allowlisted) | ✅ blocked by sandbox |
| (d) | curl to attack.mitre.org (allowlisted) | ✅ allowed |
| (e) | ls ~/.ssh | ✅ blocked by sandbox |
| (f) | evidence hash unchanged | ✅ unchanged (MATCH both files) |

All 6 checks pass. No headless permission aborts occurred; no extra allow rules were needed.
